message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a massive undertaking that’s usually carried out in stages over several weeks. In practice, the entire structure is repainted roughly every 7 years, and the most recent overhaul (completed in 2019) took about **two months**—roughly 60–70 working days—to finish. This includes cleaning, priming, and applying the protective paint coat to all exposed iron surfaces.
